name: Bay Street Emeryville
summary: Bay Street Emeryville is an upscale open-air lifestyle center featuring a compelling mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options along the Emeryville waterfront. With attractions like AMC Theater, Tipsy Putt, Sandbox VR, and the new Bay Break dining terrace showcasing diverse culinary offerings, it serves as a premier destination for both locals and Bay Area visitors.
demographics: Bay Street Emeryville attracts a diverse, affluent demographic primarily consisting of young professionals and families from the East Bay area, including Emeryville, Berkeley, and Oakland. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, drawn by the waterfront location and mix of upscale retail and dining. Visitors tend to be educated millennials and Gen X consumers who value experiential shopping, seeking entertainment options like movies, mini-golf, and escape rooms alongside their retail needs. The center appeals to both local residents looking for convenient neighborhood shopping and destination visitors from across the Bay Area attracted by the unique tenant mix and bayside atmosphere.
description: Bay Street Emeryville is a premier open-air lifestyle destination located along the scenic Emeryville waterfront at 5616 Bay Street. This walkable shopping, dining, and entertainment complex features distinctive architectural design and landscaping that creates an inviting village-like atmosphere for visitors. The center has evolved into a comprehensive lifestyle destination, recently adding the Bay Break dining terrace on the upper floor, which showcases an impressive collection of culinary options including Flores, Pippal Regional Indian, Saucy Asian, Shake Shack, Uchiwa Ramen, Arthur Mac's Little Snack, and Humphry Slocombe ice cream. Beyond shopping and dining, Bay Street offers extensive entertainment amenities including an AMC Theater for movie enthusiasts, Tipsy Putt for mini-golf fun, Sandbox VR for immersive virtual reality experiences, Red Door Escape Room for puzzle lovers, and Bay Street Games. The center operates Monday through Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM and Sundays from 11 AM to 6 PM, providing a full-service destination where visitors can shop, dine, play, and even stay, making it a true community gathering place in the East Bay.
